name: Dome spec: Europe
description: The Europe spec for the Dome generator: cover, strength class, minimum steel and bar spacing from EN 1992-1-1 (2004 edition, recommended values), and what the EN standards say on shells, sprayed concrete, loads, foam and frost. Every value names its standard, clause and how it was read. Not a substitute for the standards, a national annex or an engineer.
author: CadCraft
